## Friday March 24, at 9:30

**D**eus in adjutorium nostrum intendas <note>O God, make haste to help us</note> D. D. R. R. ... Zebaith .......... The Almighty God be praised forevermore, may his holy Name be glorified. Now John Dee, I, Raphael, have now come at God's pleasure, and at his commandment to speak with you, and to make known to you as far as it lies in my power to speak what God has sent me to declare to you: regarding the cause of your desire now at this time, John Dee. As you are an earthly man, if you desire to have help from God for such things as earthly men cannot be without while they have time here in this mortal life, you desire to have knowledge concerning hidden things, in which I, Raphael, have no delight, nor pleasure in speaking of any such earthly matter or earthly cases. But my delight is in the Almighty, and in his wisdom. But notwithstanding this request and your inward desire in God to be informed of this treasure, which these two men whom you know speak of: they once had a time appointed by God for it, and it was not used accordingly as they should have done. Now this second time, because you have a desire to have help and knowledge at the hands of the Almighty, I, Raphael, do command you and those men whom you know, that they shall not intermeddle, or take it in hand before the tenth day of January has passed. For if they do, they shall not prevail, for that is the time that God has best appointed for the said purpose, and for the quiet enjoying of it; so when that day has passed, then let them in the name of God enter into that work. And if they will be such men as they ought to be, and as God's will is that they should be—to deal faithfully and truly one with the other in deed and in word—God will then bless their good purpose, and bring it to fulfillment when they shall take it in hand to open the earth. God will presently at that instant then suffer their good purpose to take effect, and the matter to be completed and obtained, so that they shall not be put off, even if they shall hear or see anything that they dislike. Rather, they should safely stand in hope, craving at God's hand to have that good help to be a warrant between them and all hurt and danger whatsoever may happen, and so overcome. I say, if they will faithfully pray to God with their whole trust in God, God will bless their good success; if they be otherwise, then they might as well never stir, and their good success will be turned against them. So I, Raphael, have made known to you God's purpose in this your request.

->For this I have said.<-

John Dee, I, Raphael, did make known to you this desire for that secret, and that great gift that was given to you in such order and manner as you know where you did it. You never yet had the knowledge and the wisdom that God will give you concerning that, and many more such things for you. So this rare gift being taken away from you by those you know, by taking your key, and so taking it from your keeping, it was the will and purpose of God that I, Raphael, should give such ... so that you should have knowledge ... of the same. You shall take such a course .... you may obtain it again, and when you have it, you shall put it into the same chest again, and commit it to the custody and keeping of your true friend John Pontoys. And he shall and will deal faithfully and friendly with you in keeping it until such time as by that ... which you know is promised to you, that you shall receive the perfect understanding of the hidden knowledge and secrecy of God that is not as yet made known to you, and ...... as has been said, so shall you have such wisdom delivered to you by me, Raphael, that shall come in such ... and order as has been lately made known to you for your good, to be performed in such short and speedy time. And so thus much I have made known to you, as God has in store for you to be performed. Thus much I have now said, and given you the skill to keep it in such manner as I have spoken, or else you will be disappointed of that, and ... it will hide such purpose as God will have come to pass; so in his mighty power he commanded me to come. I have finished for this matter; if you have anything, ask speedily ... for I am to depart.

John Dee, if you will have all your cause then .... as you must show according to your liking and members what you have drawn, and crave for good assistance ... of ... desiring his help, and ... to her the disease....to go to such men that should give you further instruction for your best as I have said, to show to her that you have done ...... and he will ... in your case to ...... and Canterbury, and so the faith shall triumph in short time, and if this be ........

Friday, July 10, at 9:00.

->Δ. Send your light and your truth, that they may lead us and bring us to your holy mountain and your heavenly tabernacles. Amen.<-

### ->Barth. As for you, the Creator of God appears.<-

->Δ. Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord. Hallelujah.<-

> ...... Blessed be God the Father, and God the Son, and God the Holy Ghost. All honor and power be ascribed to the living God forevermore. Amen. Δ. Amen.

John Dee, I am Raphael, one of the blessed and elect Angels of the Almighty; and at his will and his good pleasure, he has commanded me to appear here at this time, to set forth the will and pleasure of the Almighty God.

John Dee, my message that I have at this time to deliver to you is of great force, regarding what God would have you do. And whereas it was said at my last appearing to this beholder <note>Edward Kelley, the scryer</note>, that I would appear again, now it has pleased God to send me to perform and make known—according to what was then said—that all things promised before should be made plainly known: what God's will is to be done in all that has been said before.

Now I make known to you the plain meaning and understanding of it.

First, you have been promised the secret knowledge and understanding of the Philosopher's Stone and of the Book of St. Dunstan, to have knowledge of them.

It has been a long time, as you know according to human reason; and to the mind of man, a few years is thought to be a long time. And now God has been your keeper, and most importantly created you, and has allowed you to have time to live to this age. And furthermore, you consider your Nativity, and considering your great age, you think it likely by your reason that the course of nature for your age will take its place <note>That he will soon die</note>. BUT John Dee, you well remember to whom in the holy Scriptures God in his mercies added fifteen years longer than the time set for him. So do not think but that God in his mercies will be as great to you. And now to come to the matter so that you understand why you did not have these rare gifts and promises performed for you: it was the will of God to keep them away, and to allow the heart of your supreme head and governor under God <note>The Monarch</note> to be hardened against you, so that you are held in no better account by him than as one who deals with Devils and by sorcery—or as you commonly term it, witchcraft. And who does, and who has informed him to be thus evil and poorly informed against you, but only the Devil, and by the hatred of your secret enemy whom you know (I mean Salisbury), and all the malice and enemies that he can use by his Devils—Maserien, Hermeloe, the four wicked ones who are accounted the four Rulers of the Air, whose names are Ories, Egym, Paynim, and Mayrary. They are the Devils that he deals with, so that through their enticing and his own, he thinks that the wisdom he receives from their hands is pleasant and good. He and his Devils seek your overthrow in all good things, and do and shall—so far as God will allow them—seek all malice and hindrance in all good causes that should be done for your benefit. Therefore now, John Dee, I am to let you understand plainly what God's will and his great purpose is for you to do, although it may seem hard to your liking, considering what you think is the weakness of your body and the course of your age. Yet, nonetheless, that same God who has been your protector and keeper until this present age, that same merciful God shall keep you and make you able to perform things that shall be made known to you. For God will not bestow such rare gifts as I have mentioned before upon those who are unworthy of such great blessings from the Almighty. For God will not bestow pearls among those who will not believe nor understand that God has any such blessings to bestow upon men. For I say to you, John Dee, that if God should or would bestow those blessings upon you, even at this present time or at any time soon to be performed and delivered to you: then, unless you should make all things plainly known of God's secrets delivered to you to your supreme head under God here upon earth, and likewise allow your enemy to be a partaker in these secrets and great gifts of God—if you would not perform as much for them as God should give you wisdom in that matter—your life would and should be speedily cut off from this life by the envy and malice of those wicked ones and by your great enemy. But God will not have it so. So if you will do as God shall command you by this message, you shall have all these messages, promises, and wisdom, both for the Philosopher's Stone, the Book of St. Dunstan, and the secret wisdom of that Jewel that was delivered, as you know, in the manner that is plainly known to you.

So now it is the will of God to allow your supreme Head's heart to be hardened against you; and likewise for your great enemy for his wicked instructions against you, God allows it to be so, even as Pharaoh's heart was hardened against the children of God; so the matter stands against you with them. It is the will of God to allow it, to the great account they shall have to give when it pleases the Almighty for that time to come when they must render their accounts to God. Now John Dee, it is the will of the Almighty to send me, Raphael, to deliver to you this message, which will seem very hard to you. Yet, as you are the servant of God and one whom God favors and loves (although the world, through wicked enemies, hates you), willingly and obediently follow that course which God in his mercies at this time shall make known to you.

You shall (if you will obey the commandment of God, made known to you by me) undertake a long journey and go where you shall have all these great mercies of God performed for you. And God will show you as much favor in the sight of God as he ever showed to *Joseph*, who was sold into bondage, as you know; and in all his imprisonment and troubles God was with him and delivered him. So, if you will follow this commandment from God delivered to you by me, *Raphael*, you shall not doubt nor waver in your mind, for God will be merciful to you, both in this life and in the life to come. And do not think God would command you to undertake such a journey unless he knows it is best for you; he will preserve you and keep you on your journey. And you shall find on your journey that God shall and will deal mercifully with you in finding relief from the affliction of the <term>stone</term>, and that the Angels of God shall direct you in your heart and mind how you should use your body for the health and comfort of your strength. And when you are at your journey's end among such friends beyond the seas as you know, God shall and will raise up for you as faithful friends (as I have said before) as *Joseph* had; so shall you be favored by God and man. For it is the will and purpose of God to have you be obedient to this which I make known to you, because you should not remain here to be beholden to those who are your mortal enemies and would rather hear of your end than hear of your well-being or any good done for you by any man. It is a grief and a spite in their hearts and minds that you should receive any help or things necessary for man's use here upon earth, which man cannot be without. And *John Dee*, I am to command you that as shortly as you can by all possible means, set your things in order regarding your <term>Wardenship</term> and in all other causes of worldly affairs. And for maintenance to further your journey, God will most graciously raise up some good friends to help you, so that you may have support on your journey. And your true friend *John Pontoys* <margin>John Pontoys.</margin> shall by God's favor come home, and he shall and will be a great aid to you in performing this course which God has commanded you by me to undertake. Where you live now in want and are beholden to those who do not love you, nor wish you well in their hearts, God would have you be where you shall do him service; and God will give you a long life <margin>Long life.</margin> in doing so and in fulfilling this his commandment and will through me, *Raphael*. I am to make this message plainly known to you at God's will and pleasure: it is his will for you to follow this course which God will have you enter into. Do not fear or mistrust the weakness of your body, for God will preserve you for such time as shall be his good will and pleasure, so that you shall have life here in this world; he will be a merciful God to deliver you from all hurts and dangers and from all infirmities, even with as much health as you have had during the many years you have lived. So God will have you follow his will in this direction, and then you shall have all things aforesaid performed for you, and you shall then have such favor that you shall behold his blessed Creatures with your mortal eyes. And if you will perform this message delivered from God by me to the utmost of your power, then God will in his mercies perform all that is promised to you. But unless you are willing and dutiful, doing as much as lies within you to fulfill this course which I have declared through God's means, God will no longer send any of his blessed Creatures to be seen by any man's earthly eyes. Therefore I command you from God, as I am his faithful Minister and blessed Angel, that you should not doubt to undertake this journey, for God will be with you and for you, and his <margin>Δ If God is with us, who can be against us.</margin> blessed Angels shall be your comfort, even as the Angel of God was the comfort to young *Tobias* in his journey; so God will deal with you in yours. And so I have delivered to you what God will have you do.

It is the will and favor of God to give you as much understanding of God's mercies yet to come as ever mortal man had delivered to him by any spiritual Creature from God. So now I have fully ended my message. Therefore, see that you, *John Dee*, be as ready to perform it to the greatest of your power, as lovingly in giving God thanks for this message delivered; because I would have you be such a person who shall not end his days in reproach and to the rejoicing of your enemies, but you shall have time and days to live, so that when you die and depart this world, you shall die with fame and memory to the end—that such a man was upon the earth <margin>Miracles.</margin> through whom God had wrought great and wonderful Miracles in his service. And thus, to God's honor and his glory, I have ended my message, yielding to God all honor, and praise, and thanks for all his blessings and his great benefits bestowed upon his Creatures, both now and forevermore. Amen. Blessed be God in all his gifts, and holy in all his works. Praised be God. Amen, Amen.

->Δ. Amen.<-

Δ. Now, O God, as I have willingly yielded to your will and commandment of undertaking a journey, I beseech you that it may stand with your good pleasure to notify to me the country, region, or city to which you would have me direct my course from this time forward.

Δ. Nothing appeared.

A Voice ...... A Voice ...... In the name of God, tomorrow at ten o'clock.

Δ. So be it.

Δ. All thanks, praise, and glory be to God the Father, God the Son, and God the Holy Ghost, now and forever. Amen.

->A Note to be considered.<-

## Mr. Ecclestone.

In the house at the breaking up of the place were these: *James Bolton, Lettice Gostwich*, a maiden, cook, and dairy-maid.

To know the house and the place within it where it is; or if it is divided into many places, which they are.
Or if anyone else is privy to it, who may give any evidence.

And whatever may make this a perfect work, to Mr. *Ecclestone's* reasonable satisfaction, most humbly and heartily I beseech God to make known now to us; and so the praise and thanks due to God for his mercies, to the best of our power, be yielded to him.

## J E S U S

> This is the Lord's doing, and it is marvelous in our eyes. He raises the poor from the dung so that he may place him with the princes of his people. Amen.

A Voice. I am Raphael who speaks; if you want me to appear, proceed quickly, for God has appointed me a great service to do.

Δ. In the Name of Jesus, we desire your answers and instructions to these articles briefly noted here.

1. Raph. *In the Name of Jesus Christ, I, Raphael, am now sent to you to deliver the answer to your question, so far as it is God's will and pleasure to command me; and I must make a short stay with you, for I have service of God commanded me in haste to be done. In his blessed Name, I have come to fulfill his will regarding your desires, and therefore, in his Name, proceed.*

1. Δ. *The name of the place.*

Raph. *John Dee, you have been a traveler, and God has always provided for you in all your journeys; such is God's favor and his mercy toward you that regarding your request and desire to know which country is best for your well-being: God has referred it to your own will to make a choice, in whatever country or city you are most inclined toward. And when you have made your choice, if it is to God's liking and for your good, it shall be directed to you; otherwise, if it is revealed that some other place would be better for you: therefore, make your own choice and preference.*

Δ.

Raph. *John Dee, he who has commanded you to undertake this journey will provide for you in Germany, or any other country wherever you go. Therefore, let your good will and preference guide you in placing yourself, whether you wish to be near England or far off.*

Δ. *Which is best, I do not know.*

Raph. *I have said that wherever you wish, God prizes your willing desire to fulfill what God commands: think only to satisfy and rest in making your own choice; God will provide for you, whichever city you have a mind or will to enter into, and God's good Angel shall always hold you and ever give you to understand what and where shall be ever best for your satisfaction when you are there. Therefore, do not worry; he, the Almighty, will provide for you, so that you shall be so governed by his goodness that all shall go well with you.*

2. Δ. *Whom shall I have in my company besides John Pontoys?*

3, 4. Raph. *John Dee, you yourself know best that without your daughter; you*

And as for *John Pontoys*, he shall be one, as your greatest comfort and special aid, next to the Almighty. Raph. *John Dee*, you have already spoken of a very good course to send them away, not all at once, but some at one time and some at another; and God shall and will give you good success in that. And let your friend *John Pontoys* provide for all such purposes, and so shall you do well.

$\Delta$. As I have been hindered in the past from fulfilling many good purposes, perhaps the King will not be willing now to grant me a license to go overseas.

Raph. He shall and will grant you a license.

6. $\Delta$. Regarding my son *Arthur*, help and comfort him in his intended travel.

Raph. If your son likes his course of travel, he shall do well in the meantime; for your sake, as his father, God will favor him. And when you are in the place where God has commanded you to go, a short time after your arrival there, you shall be able to do him good, in helping him with such things as he now lacks; then you shall take him near to you, so that he may have the comfort of your fatherly help, and you may have the comfort of his well-doing. And so for this, I have certified you.

7. $\Delta$. Shall I not at any time return here to England again?

Raph. You shall be better able in health and strength of your body to come to England again, if you wish; but you shall see and perceive yourself so mercifully provided for, that you will have little mind or willingness to come to England again, such shall God's great mercies be toward you.

$\Delta$. Then I perceive that I shall not place much importance on keeping my house at *Mortlake* for any return here.

### Mr. Eccleston’s case regarding his money taken away by one Thomas Webster, &c.

Raph. You are taking a difficult matter in hand. This man *Thomas Webster* had it, and has it in his keeping still, but he will not admit that he has it. And if *Eccleston* deals with him by extreme measures, he shall prevail little; he shall not obtain his purpose that way. But by dealing friendly with the party, and by offering him a share of it, he may yield to *Eccleston*. Otherwise, the matter will become difficult. I would, from God, advise you, *John Dee*, to involve yourself in as few of these matters as possible, for this will not be accomplished unless he proceeds into the man's house according to the Law; and then he shall entangle himself in trouble, and be no better off for the thing itself. But, as I have said, by friendly dealing he may yield, and as far as it pleases God, I will work by God's favor to make him yield. And I have said this much, and let it suffice.

It remains for now in a chest that is somewhat white in color, but if he is disturbed, he will then remove it and hide it in the ground in a little parlor that he has. And so I have spoken and answered you at this time, as concerning—

$\Delta$. Money was sent to me from the Emperor by *Hans Bik*; I wonder that it has not yet arrived here.

Raph. Regarding that, *John Pontoys* will make all known to you for your good. And in whose Name, and in whose Power I came, so now again I return to that place, to which in His mercies may He bring all His blessed creatures, yielding all honor and praise to His holy Name. I end. Amen, Amen.

->$\Delta$. Amen.<-

## July 14, at 11:30.

$\Delta$. As I sat at dinner with *Bartholomew Hickman*, my daughter, *Patrick* and *Thomas Turner*, near the end of the dinner *Bartholomew* heard a voice saying: "Tomorrow at half past nine, give your attendance to know the Lord's pleasure."

$\Delta$. As near as I remember, that is what he said, or to that effect.

> John Dee, God knows all of this that you speak of. In a few words, to end many words, he will so direct your ways in ending such troubles, as shall lead to your benefit and a speedy conclusion.

> Regarding John Pontoyes: before the time that you shall have any great cause to use his aid, God will so work for you in the heart of his Master (for whom he is an agent)—I mean Stapers—that Stapers shall, with all the aid and help he can, further your good progress. And so God, in all cases, will deal thus graciously with you. And now it is my full time to depart in God's peace, and to serve him from whom I came, his mighty Name.

Δ. Fearing his sudden departure, I earnestly urged him to let me know the truth of the history of Tobias; and so, somewhat rudely, I interrupted his speech with my question.

> John Dee, I am Raphael, who is appointed by God to be your guide in this journey of yours; and I am that same Raphael who was the guide to young Tobias in his long journey, and delivered him from the power of the wicked spirit *Asmodeus*, who had, as you know, destroyed many; and I brought him through God's power home again, and delivered him in health to his own parents. And thus much I have made you plainly understand, without any doubt to the contrary. And so now, once again, I depart. All honor and glory to the everlasting God, both now and forevermore. Amen, Amen.

### 17 July.

After dinner (around 4:30 PM), as *Bartholomew* and I talked of various things I had done with Mr. *Kelley*, a Voice produced this for *Bartholomew* to hear:

> A Voice. . . . . I, John Dee, I have heard you all this while.
> You shall be able to do, and to see, and to understand more than all this that you have spoken of, according as God has promised you.

Δ. Blessed be his holy Name, and may his mercies be magnified upon me, to the honor of his holy Name. Amen.

Δ. Note . . . . Upon the occasion of further talk and speech regarding my Jewel that was brought, I asked *Bartholomew* if he had ever seen it since it was set in gold; and he thought that he had not seen it. Whereupon I went quickly to my chest, unlocked it, took it out, opened the case, and set the stone in its proper manner.

And immediately *Raphael* appeared in the stone, and in a voice said as follows:

And likewise, you shall have the book from which this came. And that dust which you have in your keeping (which you consider to be nothing better than dust) shall then be turned to its proper use, from which it originated, and to that good purpose that God has ordained for it. And now it was the will of God that I should speak to you a few words of this good comfort to be fulfilled. Praise God, honor his holy Name for his great blessings now and forever; for it pleased the Almighty to send me into your presence as a token of his love, for his great mercy. And so now, in his Name, I go again into the presence of the Almighty, whose Name be ever praised, with all his elect angels, and all the blessed creatures of God, and all the blessed creatures upon earth, praise his Name forevermore. > Send out your light and your truth, Lord, that they may lead us and bring us to your holy mountain and to your heavenly tabernacles. Amen.

**O** *most merciful Lord and Savior Christ Jesus, who is and was the Creator and Redeemer of mankind, and of all his blessed creatures. In his power I, Raphael, am now come at his will and commandment, and so likewise at his good pleasure I must then return at such time as he has commanded me.*

*John Dee, in the name of the Most Highest, I am come to deliver to you this my message, which God in his goodness has commanded me.*

*First, I, Raphael, am sent of God at this time most chiefly to put you in that good remembrance of my last appearing in your presence, to let you understand that whatever course God in his mercies did set down then, and what way you should take to enter into this journey, which God in his goodness is most willing that you should enter into. For, John Dee, God has declared, and made manifestly known to you at my last appearing, what service God would use you for; and all such purposes that were spoken of the last time shall be, by God's favor and his merciful good gift, performed for you. And do not fear, for God will safely help and preserve your body in your journey, to the end that you should be in that place where you might have time to enter into all such service as God has made known to you through me. For, John Dee, such has God's mercies been in allowing wicked men to prevail against you, and they have made and do make a scorn of you here in this your native country. So it is with you as it was with Christ and his Apostles, being most cruelly used in their own native countries; so John Dee, God has allowed those wicked men to pull you down in worldly affairs, which should be maintenance for you and for your family, and which a man cannot be without while he is here in this vale of misery. Such wicked men have most cruelly used you, even as Job was by God's permission, who allowed the Devil to prevail against him. Yet God's mercies are so great toward you that, although they (most wickedly) have robbed you of your possessions, yet God would not allow those wicked ones by any of their malicious practices to prevail in any way to hurt your body, as Job's was. For if they (through their wicked purposes) could have wrought such cruelty against you, you would not have been a living man here upon earth until this time. So, John Dee, you do know who is your mortal enemy, who rules next to your earthly King.*

<margin>$\Delta$.</margin>

*Why, you may well know, for I have made it known before this time to you, that he is not your friend, though you have not offended him in any way. Therefore, because this your native country is not a place fit for God's purposes in his wisdom to be bestowed upon you here; therefore, at my last message, God did send me to make known to you where he would have you go, so that there you might be a man; and that man whom God has appointed to make his wisdom known. For you are that man whom God has chosen, so that (accordingly as it was said yesterday) no mortal man in the flesh, except only Enoch, had or shall have such wisdom made known, to be plainly understood by any man, as you yourself shall understand and receive at the hands of the Almighty. Therefore it is the will and purpose of God that he would have you in that country, for this your native country is not worthy of the gifts that you shall receive at the hands of God to come, nor to be made known to those who are not worthy of such great gifts of God's wisdom.*

*Therefore, John Dee, in all these matters which are in favor at this time made known to you, the chief and greatest cause of this my coming to you is to make the matter plainly known: that God in his mercies would have you, with all the diligence you possibly can, to hasten to 그 country where God commands you; and at my last being here you*

You know what my message was; therefore, do your best to fulfill it as you can, and God will give his great help to you in strengthening your body and otherwise, which shall be for your benefit. And once you are in that place where God would have you be, you shall well perceive and plainly understand that God will most mercifully work with you for your benefit in performing all such promises which have been made known to you both the last time and at this time.

*John Dee*, I remind you that while you said a portion of money was sent to you from the Emperor, I tell you that the Devil, working in the heart of one of your enemies (I mean Cook <note>Likely Sir Edward Coke, a known antagonist of Dee</note>), sought ways through his false, persistent, evil speeches—in a most deceitful manner to someone who informed the Emperor—to hinder you by saying false things to your discredit (as he thought), so that you would not receive any help or credit from the Emperor's hand. But *John Dee*, be of good comfort: the Emperor of all Emperors will be your comfort and aid you, and forever put down your enemies. Regarding the Emperor (from whom you should have received that portion of money), it shall be such that he will have more need of you and the wisdom God shall deliver to you; for you shall have no need of him, except only to maintain goodwill and friendship between him and you, by showing yourself friendly toward him, as God shall hereafter give you plainly to understand.

Now, *John Dee*, I have made known to you what God's will is in this message of mine. This is the greatest and the most principal reason why God has sent me to you at this present time. And now I have, through God’s mercies, delivered this his Commandment to you; and for this, I have now spoken and finished.

<margin>$\Delta$</margin> Blessed be the Almighty God, now and for ever.

<margin>$\Delta$</margin> I would have gladly understood how much the portion was which the Emperor would have sent me.

*John Dee*, let it go, and speak no further of it; for you may be joyful, as it is said to you that he shall have need of you, and not you of him. Therefore, reason no more in that matter.

<margin>$\Delta$</margin> As concerning Mr. *Eccleston*.

*John Dee, in few words I answer you: He has dealt with the parties in those affairs, but the chief party will not, as yet, allow anything to be made known, but stubbornly and stoutly stands in his own defense. And God’s Creatures <note>Angels or spirits</note> have worked with him, yet he will yield to nothing (as yet), unless those Creatures should deal so cruelly with him as to pull him to pieces; this is his wicked stubbornness. But God will bring the matter to light; however,* Eccleston *has not dealt with the matter as well as he might have done; he is far too slack in his own cause. Therefore, if the fault is in him, then do not blame the Creatures of God. For God could (as you very well know) command that said Treasure to be brought; but he will not have it be so, because it shall come among men by other means. So God has a great care and purpose to do everything for your benefit, to keep matters free from the blame and slander of the world, as might happen if it should come by any other way than by this plan which is laid out. And when it is the will of God that it shall be delivered, God will so perform it, if man will do as he should do, in all reverent manner toward God. And so now I let you perceive and know that it is not yet obtained.*

<margin>$\Delta$</margin> Whether has the other party confessed anything?

Raph. *He has not yet yielded openly; but he has secretly persuaded his fellow that the matter might be made known to* Eccleston *by confessing the whole matter, but the other will not yet yield. But it would be better for him to yield at first than to wait any longer; the less would be his punishment from God for it. And so I let you understand that you shall give God his time to work in that matter at his pleasure, and then it shall be for the benefit of the owner and of you likewise. And now I have spoken.*

<margin>$\Delta$</margin> Concerning the depriving me of my own goods, I would gladly understand who has my silver double-gilt bell-Salt <note>A bell-shaped salt cellar</note>, and other things recently stolen from me.

Raph. *John Dee, this is the will and purpose of God to command you: although you suffer wrong because your goods are taken from you, yet God’s will is such that he would have you be a peacemaker in this cause, for it is beyond help to have it back again. But as you are a mortal father, so handle that matter as a father, for your son had it, although he would not and will not confess it. And likewise for such things recently missing about this house, you shall hereafter know as plainly who had them and how they were gone as you now plainly understand regarding your Salt; but you shall wait and proceed no further until such time as I, Raphael, shall speak further of it, for God will have all things done well and to his best liking. So, for that, I have now spoken.*

Vanlah oha demageus ou sanfah, paphah olemueh, ozadcha lax ornah vor adme ox Vastmah grelabazna, gamnacho astmah ochado laudridah vons fah, lugho iahat nabscham nobads vandispa rossamod audroch alpob zumbloh asnah gonfageph aldeh lo dab vax orb asnis gad av dan se qua deo, dath vax nograh vox fegbat Mon.

7. Arni olbah galpa lohanaha gaupumagensah ollo var se darfah goho albvmielamacapaloth who nad versah vors ardnu imnony asquam rath als vasmah genda loggakab astmv.

8. Arnah notab lax vart lvboh defmaphi ol eapraminacah oxandahvah gemveloriphitonpha attamplahnofstapha ormaxadahahar orzemblizadmah panchefelogedoh aschah olmah ledoh vaxma.

9. Cans na Cap lan seda ax nor vorza vo. Las pral onsa gem gemah noph gazo na von saulfa nostradg ansel unfa pah vort velsa or alda viax nor adroh semneb ols vandesqual olzab nolpax pahab lothar ax rv varsar glminaph gath ardot ardri axa noh gaga leth arde maxa.

10. Carsal mabah nophch alps arford vord vansax oriox nabat gemnepoh laphet foda nat vombal nams argeth alloah nephirt lauda noxa voxtaf ardno androch labmageth ossu almaglo ardet nalbar vanse darto vorts parsan ur unrab vor gadeth leth orze nax vomreh gelpha, legar or nembla ox ar vah su.

11. Zanchevmachaseph, olzaminoah Valseburaah nodeliganax orsapnago darsagnapha nobsiblith armipyth arsepolimitantons Jembulsamar leboge axpar ornaza oldaxardacoah.

12. Semno ab al ehi do a cha da Selpagmodah a da hu ba mi ca noh dam pha gli af cha nor ox om pa mi na pho. lemp, na, gou, fa, pha ne co al pha af pa ge mo cal. na tu rage.

13. Sen gal se quar ruf fa glau fur tast ormaca oxinodal ge brah nop tar na gel vom na chef pal ma cax arfess asdon fadg afc lan fau che dah nor vi car max coh zum bla xan-pha ad geb do ca ba ah.

14. Ar gem na ca pal sax, or nido hab cas pigan alpuh gagah loth zal sa bra dan go sa pax vol san ques tan ondapha opicab or zy la pa a chra pa ma les ad ma carpah oxalps on da pa, gem na de vor guse.

15. Lat gaus sa par sat lasteah lor adab nox ax ardephes nousou andoh gumzi vor sab liboh ad ni sa pa loh gaho lar va nox ax obo lan sempah noxa Uriah sephah lufas oldgalsax nottaph ax vernoc arpos arla zem zubah, lotkor gas lubah vom xa da phi ca no.

16. Assotaphe ondah Vor ban sanphar pa loth agno jam nesrob am algors vrrabah geuseb alde ox nab vors purblox amplicato nostroph admadg or napfv asmo lon gamphi arbel nos amphi on sembelob aschi nar lassax las doxa pra gem a fesirox amphi nax var sembleh.

17. Angefel orcapacad onz adq ochadah olzah vor nab orpogographel al sa gem na ca pi coh. Ul da pa por sah naxor vonsa rous Erbaus lab dun zaph algades lob gem vorta ob amph a boha za vaxorza lepteh oxor neoh ah va dv na ca pi ca lodox ard nah.
